columns.comment: Watchlist event id (WLE-nnnnnn).
columns.name: event_id

columns.comment: Credit obligor record the event belongs to.
columns.name: obligor_id

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Date of the watchlist event.
columns.name: event_date

columns.comment: Added, Escalated, De-escalated or Removed.
columns.name: event_type

columns.comment: Final EWS band before the event (Green, Amber, Red).
columns.name: band_from

columns.comment: Final EWS band after the event.
columns.name: band_to

columns.comment: Composite EWS score (0-100) of the month that triggered the event.
columns.name: composite_score

columns.comment: Dominant EWS driver: Credit, Liquidity, Behavioural or External.
columns.name: lead_category

columns.comment: Watchlist reason, e.g. Credit deterioration (health / utilisation / covenant), Deposit outflow.
columns.name: lead_reason

columns.comment: CRM code of the RM owning the watchlist action (RM001-RM120).
columns.name: owner_rm_code

columns.comment: Owner RM as employee_id; join to gold.dim_employee.
columns.name: owner_employee_id

columns.comment: Owner RM name (fictional).
columns.name: owner_name

columns.comment: Action plan required by the event: Watchlist credit review (Added), Recovery / exit plan (Escalated), Monitoring update (De-escalated); null for Removed.
columns.name: action_type

columns.comment: Due date of the action plan (30 days after an addition, 21 after an escalation).
columns.name: action_due_date

columns.comment: Date the action was completed; null while open.
columns.name: action_completed_date

columns.comment: Action status at the as-of date: Completed, Open (not yet due) or Overdue; null for removals.
columns.name: action_status

columns.comment: Days the open action is past due at the as-of date (0 otherwise).
columns.name: action_days_overdue

columns.comment: True when the action plan is overdue at the as-of date (watchlist actions overdue).
columns.name: is_action_overdue

columns.comment: True when the action plan is not yet completed (Open or Overdue).
columns.name: is_action_open

columns.comment: True for the obligor's latest watchlist event to the as-of date.
columns.name: is_latest_event

columns.comment: True on the latest event of obligors still on the watchlist at 30-Sep-2026 (latest event is not a removal).
columns.name: is_on_watchlist_as_of

columns.comment: Next scheduled watchlist review of names still on the list (on their latest event).
columns.name: next_review_date

columns.comment: Client's drawn lending exposure at the event month-end, USD.
columns.name: exposure_drawn_usd

columns.comment: Client's exposure at default in the event month, USD.
columns.name: ead_usd

columns.comment: Client's IFRS 9 expected credit loss in the event month, USD.
columns.name: ecl_usd

comment: Credit watchlist register events (brief 5.4), Apr-2024 to Sep-2026: one row per event - Added (final EWS band left Green), Escalated (to Red), De-escalated (Red to Amber), Removed (back to Green) - with the band move, composite score, lead reason, owner RM, the review action plan (watchlist credit review, recovery / exit plan, monitoring update) with its due / completed dates and status as of 30-Sep-2026 (Completed, Open, Overdue), and the client's drawn exposure, EAD and ECL at the event month-end. is_on_watchlist_as_of marks each listed client's latest event (count those for watchlist clients today). Grain: one row per watchlist event.
